name: FEVER: Fact Extraction and VERification
description: FEVER (Fact Extraction and VERification) is a benchmark dataset for automated fact checking and verification. Comprising 185,445 claims generated by altering sentences extracted from Wikipedia and subsequently verified by human annotators into Supports, Refutes, or NotEnoughInfo, along with evidence sentence annotations.
